data.title: Al-Qasab Salt Season Opens for Fourth Edition under the Patronage of Housing and Municipalities Minister
data.content:
Al-Qasab, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The fourth edition of Al-Qasab Salt Season kicked off yesterday at the heritage village in Al-Qasab town under the patronage of Minister of Municipalities and Housing Majed Al-Hogail and in the presence of Minister of Commerce Majid Al-Kassabi. The event runs until November 28.
    The season recreates aspects of life in Al-Qasab during the late 13th century AH. It introduces visitors to the traditional craft of salt extraction, which has been passed down through generations for more than three centuries. At a model saltworks, visitors can explore the stages of salt production, from manual extraction from pits locally known as "Jifar Al-Milh" to purification, packaging, domestic marketing, and export.
    Visitors can also tour several palaces and museums in the heritage village and visit the Heritage Commission's visitor center. The season also offers activities for the whole family and features attractions such as a cultural theater, a salt-themed rest area, an Al-Qasab arts zone, a children's corner, and traditional houses.
    -- SPA
